# AeroBrowse
> The featherweight, dual-engine AI browser designed for autonomous agents, LLM pipelines, and web scraping.

AeroBrowse reduces LLM token consumption by up to 92% using semantic accessibility AST pruning, while offering complete web compatibility via a tiered hybrid architecture (Turbo Mode in pure Rust + Fidelity Mode via native Chrome DevTools Protocol).

## Core Concepts & Documentation
- [Quickstart Guide](https://github.com/k39139215-gif/aerobrowse#quickstart): 3-step guide to installing and running AeroBrowse via CLI, Python SDK, or native Rust binary.
- [Dual-Engine Architecture](https://github.com/k39139215-gif/aerobrowse#the-aerospace-analogy-why-aero): How Turbo Mode (<15MB RAM, sub-100ms) and Fidelity Mode (100% Blink/V8 JS) operate.
- [Autonomous Engine Routing](https://github.com/k39139215-gif/aerobrowse#autonomous-routing): How AeroBrowse automatically detects SPAs and escalates to Fidelity Mode.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://github.com/k39139215-gif/aerobrowse#model-context-protocol-mcp-integration): Connecting AeroBrowse directly to Claude Desktop, Cursor AI, and Antigravity.
- [Empirical Benchmarks](https://github.com/k39139215-gif/aerobrowse#live-empirical-benchmarks): Side-by-side performance, RAM, and token metrics across 8 real-world domains.

## CLI Usage
- `aerobrowse fetch <URL>`: Fetches URL using Turbo Mode with sub-100ms latency and 90% token reduction.
- `aerobrowse fetch <URL> --fidelity`: Forces full Blink/V8 JavaScript execution and dynamic DOM hydration.
- `aerobrowse click <URL> <ACTION_ID>`: Dispatches native DOM clicks by numeric element ID.
- `aerobrowse fill <URL> <ACTION_ID> <TEXT>`: Fills form inputs and search fields by numeric element ID.
- `aerobrowse mcp`: Launches native JSON-RPC stdio MCP server for AI IDEs.

## Python SDK
```python
from aerobrowse import AeroBrowser

browser = AeroBrowser()

# Auto-routes between Turbo and Fidelity based on page content
result = browser.fetch("https://news.ycombinator.com")
print(result["markdown"])
print(f"Token reduction: {result['reduction_pct']}%")

# Interactive control via numbered action elements
browser.fetch("https://example.com/login", force_fidelity=True)
browser.fill("1", "admin@example.com")
browser.fill("2", "secret_pass")
browser.click("3")
```

## Key Capabilities
- **Token Pruning**: Strips SVG paths, inline CSS, script tags, and junk while preserving 100% semantic text and hierarchy.
- **Set-of-Marks Action Indexing**: Maps all clickable links, buttons, and inputs to simple integers `[1]`, `[2]`, `[3]` for zero-hallucination agent navigation.
- **Zero Heavy Dependencies**: Standalone 4.7MB binary available for Windows, Linux, and macOS ARM64. Uses system-installed Edge/Chrome for Fidelity Mode without downloading 300MB Chromium packages.
